title: My Little Step Children
text: most girls like dolls but not every girl wants to be a mommy wait where's your doll she won't be joining us introducing my little stepchildren I bought my kid a doll and I asked her Lisa are you her mommy and she said mommy where's the drama in that I'm her wicked step mommy every little stepchild comes with a tiny cardboard birth certificate kids can lock inside an ornate chest of drawers then they can pretend to avoid questions about the doll's birth mother why all the questions Marjorie you're just being silly again some kids gut instinct is to go dark why not embrace it my little stepchildren are perfect for kids with a flair for the dramatic they'll love staging a scene where the little stepchildren get sent away to boarding school this is for the best the first time I bought Lisa a doll she said she felt no real connection to her she said she felt no real connection to her she said she felt no real connection to her she said she felt no real connection to it like there was a sheet of glass between her and the doll with my little stepchildren she no longer feels forced to change that yes so beautiful but for how long wait so who's the doll's father I guess a handsome widower named Richard so our daughter is married to this guy not for the right reasons what are you doing sweetie throwing her birth mother sliders into the fire both girls and boys can menacingly reveal their big, gorgeous engagement ring to their stepchildren. I won. I got your daddy wrapped around my finger. My little stepchildren. Hey, some kids live for the drama. She never wanted kids. She just wanted Richard. But Richard comes with kids. Yeah, well, that's not her fault.
